headline: If AI writes the code,
do we still need static analysis?
bullets: LLM agents find and fix bugs, but how many?

headline: 488 real bugs,

headline: 55.6% on the bugs of its kind,
53.1% of all 488 vs 4.5% by agents
bullets: 259 of 488 bugs: a Parasoft finding inside the changed code
90 of the 162 mechanism bugs: 55.6%, well past the 50% mark
Full codebase scans, every file the build compiles, no hints
Same code, same bugs, published benchmark

headline: What this benchmark
does not claim
bullets: A flag is a lead for an engineer, not a fix
The agents had to make hidden tests pass; we measure detection
Not every flagged rule is the real bug

headline: Only a third of the bugs
are static analysis's kind of bug
bullets: 162 of 488: memory, resource, and error handling defects
Parasoft on that third: 55.6%, clearing the 50% mark
